result.rationale: A single 400 mg ibuprofen dose at 26 weeks is very unlikely to cause harm; concerns arise mainly with repeated or prolonged use, especially at 20+ weeks (fetal renal/amniotic fluid effects) and 30+ weeks (ductus arteriosus). Shoulder pain resolved, patient feels well, fetal movements normal. Guidance: avoid further NSAIDs, use acetaminophen if needed, mention at next prenatal visit; seek care if decreased fetal movement or other symptoms develop.
